summary: The study focuses on the ALD deposition of TaN on porous low-k films to prevent Ta penetration during Cu interconnect fabrication. The etch-byproduct from stopper etching is used as a pore-sealing technique to prevent metal penetration, and the effectiveness of this method is demonstrated through TEM and XPS analysis.
evidence: ALD-TaN (1 nm) was deposited by cyclic exposure of pentakisdimethylaminotantalum [Ta(N(CH3)2)5: PDMAT]/Ar/NH3/Ar on these substrates. The trench was electrochemically filled with Cu, and the samples were annealed at 350 /C14 C for 30 min in N2/H2 ambient.
